subject: Meridian service surge: RCA delivery, exec commitments, and remediation timeline
messages:
From: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@meridianretail.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meridian Ops <ops@meridianretail.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected throughput drop + elevated 5xx this morning

Soojin,

Heads up — we saw a sustained throughput degradation and spike in 5xx errors across our endpoints between 08:50 and 09:25 PDT this morning. Key details from our side:
- ~35% drop in requests/sec for the /generate route
- 4xx stayed stable; 5xx increased from ~0.2% baseline to ~3.8%
- Error samples attached (request IDs) and a graph in the PNG  — ops included.

This impacted customer-facing search suggestions and triggered our circuit-breakers briefly. Can you share an immediate triage note, an ETA for root cause analysis, and whether you anticipate follow-up downtime? Our execs are asking for an RCA and a plan by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Lisa
Director, Platform Ops
Meridian Retail

Attachments: throughput-graphs.png
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@meridianretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected throughput drop + elevated 5xx this morning

Lisa — thanks for the signal and the samples. A quick ack and immediate plan from our side: 
1) Triage lead: Karthik is taking the incident lead and is already on the logs/metrics.
2) Short-term mitigation: we will pin a subset of requests to a fallback model variant (lower memory pressure) while we analyze KV cache behavior.
3) Bridge: scheduled 09:45 PDT; invite just sent to ops + engineering.
4) Deliverables: preliminary findings in 2–3 hours; full RCA draft and proposed remediation timeline by EOD tomorrow (10/12).

We will include request IDs, exact kernel/quantization variants in the RCA. I will follow up with the meeting notes and a single-slide exec summary for your leadership.

— Soojin
Principal Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment references: throughput-graphs.png (from Meridian)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@meridianretail.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected throughput drop + elevated 5xx this morning

Lisa / Soojin — quick technical summary from the morning triage (preliminary):
- Root symptom: sudden spike in KV cache miss rate for long-running session keys on a subset of inference pods (hot shard). CPU and GPU utilization rose on those pods; latency climbed and backend retries produced elevated 5xxs.
- Likely trigger: small code-path change in request routing last week exposed a skew in session affinity under bursty request patterns.
- Mitigation performed at 10:05 PDT: temporarily routed 30% of traffic to a warmed pool (pools pinned to smaller context lengths), reduced per-request memory allocation by selecting the fallback model variant (redwood-v1-small) for high-throughput endpoints. That brought 5xx back to baseline by ~10:20.

Next steps / action items (we are preparing a formal action-sheet):
A. Short term (done): traffic routing change + fallback variant (complete).
B. Near term (24–72 hours): patch to routing logic to avoid affinity imbalance; better KV cache backpressure control and improved guardrails on per-pod cold-starts.
C. Mid term (2–4 weeks): capacity rebalancing automation + test harness for synthetic burst patterns.

I attached the postmortem action sheet with owners and dates; will follow up with the RCA PDF for your review.

— Karthik
Sr. Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: postmortem-action-sheet.xlsx

> Soojin,
>
> Heads up — we saw a sustained throughput degradation and spike in 5xx errors across our endpoints between 08:50 and 09:25 PDT this morning...
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@meridianretail.com>; Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Meridian surge — exec summary, credits, and remediation commitments

Lisa / Meridian leadership — following up with an executive summary and formal commitments: 
1) What happened (summary): a routing imbalance caused a subset of inference pods to experience cache pressure under a burst pattern, which increased latency and surfaced transient 5xxs. The issue was mitigated by routing changes and fallback model routing; full mitigation was applied within ~35 minutes of detection.
2) Customer impact: degraded user experience for ~35 minutes; estimate ~0.5% of active users impacted for request timeouts / retries.
3) Financial / commercial: Redwood proposes a one-time service credit equivalent to 10% of October usage for Meridian while we complete the RCA review (open to discussion).
4) Remediation plan and timelines:
   - Patch routing logic (owner: Karthik) — delivery by 2027-10-15
   - Add KV backpressure guardrails and alerting (owner: Lauren) — delivery by 2027-10-22
   - Synthetic burst test harness + runbook (owner: Soojin) — delivery by 2027-11-05
5) Accountability: weekly sync for 4 weeks; Redwood will provide a compliance log showing routing/patch rollouts and test results.

As requested, we have attached the draft RCA (PDF) and the action sheet with named owners and target dates. Please confirm that the remediation plan and the proposed credit look acceptable to Meridian leadership; we will put the patch into canary 10/14 and fully roll 10/15 pending your approval.

— Jordan Blake
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: meridian-rca-draft.pdf, postmortem-action-sheet.xlsx
From: Lisa Carter <lisa.carter@meridianretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian surge — exec summary, credits, and remediation commitments

Thanks — appreciate the rapid triage and the clear commitments. Meridian accepts the proposed timeline for fixes and the temporary credit; we would like the RCA to include: 
- exact request IDs and timestamps (we have shared ours)
- the code change that precipitated the affinity skew (commit hash)
- a short timeline of the mitigation steps and who executed them

We will join the canary monitoring window on 10/14 for the rollout. Please send a short, single-slide executive readout for our CFO before EOD 10/15.

Lisa
Director, Platform Ops
Meridian Retail
